newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy used car market outlook gloomy -report.
newsitem.headline: Italy used car market outlook gloomy -report.

text.p: Italy's used car market had another bad month in March, continuing to be hit by the government's incentive scheme to buy new cars for old introduced in January, auto forecasting body Centro Studi Promotor (CSP).
CSP said in its latest study that 79 percent of dealers surveyed reported a low level of deliveries with only two percent declaring themselves satisfied with the situation.
Some 71 percent of dealers said they had high levels of stocks of used cars remaining unsold.

Forecasts for the months ahead tended to be pessimistic, with 38 percent of dealers polled saying they expected a further fall in demand, 55 percent seeing a flat market and only seven percent hopeful of a recovery.
